Title: SafeMedia
Description: Refuses unsafe SVG and PDF uploads before they are stored. Allowing SVG uploads in Umbraco quietly opens stored cross-site scripting, and a PDF can carry scripts and launch actions to anyone who downloads it. SafeMedia checks every file with parser-based, allowlist rules that reject rather than strip, and a health check finds unsafe files already in your media library. Secure with zero configuration. Free and MIT licensed.
